There have been documented instances where robots misconstrued symptoms due to a lack of contextual comprehension. Surveys gauging patients' experiences with robotic-assisted care as opposed to fully human care can furnish qualitative insights. Additionally, dissecting medical malpractice data related to robotic procedures can help us evaluate the risks.
